definitions.free_flow_mph: p85 of the zone's hour-of-week median speeds over 02:00-05:59 (28 cells, each >= 30 trips, >= 14 valid cells), all services
definitions.mean_trips: trips per occurrence of that hour-of-week in 2024 (DST-aware denominators), pickup zone; null = suppressed (1..10 annual trips)
definitions.speed_mph: median trip speed; null when fewer than 11 trips
definitions.speed_ratio: median speed / zone free-flow speed; null when cell has < 30 trips or zone free flow undefined
definitions.vref: p95 of the zone's 168 hourly mean trips (all services); used as the BPR capacity normalization

layout: columnar, flat zone-major: index = zoneIndex*168 + how, how = dow*24 + hour (dow 0=Mon). zoneIndex = position in `zones`
